card.name: Spots before biology and genetics terms
card.fires_on: Fires on spaces, digits, and word pieces just before a number or term in lab, genetics and molecular biology text. Examples are the space before a centrifuge time or speed, and digits inside years or residue numbers.

modes.label: Space before a lab number
modes.description: A bare space just before a quantity such as a time or speed in a lab protocol or study.
modes.example: Immediately centrifuge the capped WBC tube at 400-450 g for<< >>5 minutes.

modes.label: Digits in citations and residues
modes.description: A digit inside a year, section number, or amino acid residue label.

modes.label: Inside genetics and protein terms
modes.description: A word piece or word within a name in genetics or biochemistry text.

card.writes: It suppresses bio- and gene words such as Bio, DNA and 基因, so it lowers the chance of a biology term coming next.
card.plain: It marks spots in science text where a number or name is about to come, and it makes a biology word less likely next.
